play.no_build: Install a game version first (Versions tab).
play.exited: The game ended normally (exit code {code}, {seconds} s).
play.crashed: The game crashed (exit code {code}, after {seconds} s).
play.no_news: No news in the mod index.
play.no_news_source: Add a mod index in Settings to see news here.
play.summary: {builds} game versions installed · {enabled} of {mods} mods enabled in this profile
profile.remove_body: The profile {profile} is removed from the list. Its game folder with saves and mods stays on disk.
profile.name: Name
profile.hint: Changes are saved at once. The game folder holds this profile's saves, settings and mods.
mods.none: No mods in this profile yet. Browse the index or import a zip.
mods.has_code_hint: This mod carries Wasm code. It runs inside the game's sandbox, but only enable mods you trust.
mods.installed_disabled: Installed {id}. It is disabled until you enable it.
mods.enable_warning: Mods are made by other people. Enable only mods from sources you trust.
mods.declares_code: Runs code: {file} (Wasm, in the game's sandbox)
mods.remove_body: {name} is deleted from this profile's mods folder.
problem.duplicate: Another mod has the same id; the game will refuse to start.
problem.unknown_keys: mod.json has keys the game refuses: {keys}
problem.incompatible: Made for game {range}, this profile uses {game}.
browse.no_index: No mod index is set up.
browse.pick: Pick a mod on the left.
browse.install_note: Downloads are checked against the index's SHA-256. New mods start disabled.
browse.no_fitting_version: No version fits this game version.
versions.none: No game version yet. Download a release below or add a folder with a build.
versions.remove_body: {version} is removed. A version the launcher downloaded is deleted; a folder you added stays on disk.
settings.offline_hint: Use only installed versions and the cached index
settings.token_hint: Stored in a private file in the config folder, never in launcher.json. Leave empty and save to delete it. CASTANEA_GITHUB_TOKEN overrides it.
settings.indexes_hint: An index is one JSON file (docs/mod-index.md). The first index that lists a mod wins.
about.text: Starts castanea, keeps several game versions side by side, and manages and finds mods.
about.security_text: Downloads use HTTPS only and are checked against a SHA-256 from the index or the release. The launcher runs no downloaded code except the game version you pick. New mods start disabled; before enabling one you see what it declares.
